sql: WITH last AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.market_ticker) s.* FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.at > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY s.market_ticker, s.at DESC), prog AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) * FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type='liquidity' AND end_date > now() + interval '24 hours' ORDER BY market_ticker, last_seen_at DESC), j AS ( SELECT l.market_ticker mkt, l.best_yes_bid y, l.best_no_bid n, l.est_yes_score_total fy, l.est_no_score_total fn, (l.est_yes_meets_target AND l.est_no_meets_target) q, p.target_size::float tgt, p.period_reward_usd/ nullif(extract(epoch from p.end_date - p.start_date)/86400,0) pool_day, extract(epoch from p.close_time - now())/86400 close_d FROM last l JOIN prog p USING (market_ticker)) SELECT mkt, y||'/'||n AS px, round(close_d) AS close_d, tgt::int AS tgt, round(least(fy,fn)::numeric) AS field, round(pool_day::numeric,2) AS pool_day, round((100*(500/(fy+500)+500/(fn+500))/2)::numeric,1) AS sh500, round((pool_day*(500/(fy+500)+500/(fn+500))/2)::numeric,2) AS day500, round((100*(2000/(fy+2000)+2000/(fn+2000))/2)::numeric,1) AS sh2000, round((pool_day*(2000/(fy+2000)+2000/(fn+2000))/2)::numeric,2) AS day2000, round((pool_day*(5000/(fy+5000)+5000/(fn+5000))/2)::numeric,2) AS day5000 FROM j WHERE q AND y BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND n BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND close_d BETWEEN 7 AND 60 AND fy > 0 AND fn > 0 ORDER BY day500 DESC LIMIT 20
